name: Villain's Legacy
source:
The world is constantly on the brink of collapse. Invaders from outer space trying to enslave the human race, mad scientists quivering to conquer the planet, creatures from other dimensions feed on fear and despair of the people. But none of this will ever happen, because THEY, are ready to defend the Earth at any cost!

Superheroes. Beautiful, powerful ones. Born from dangerous genetic experiments, coming from other galaxies, or gifted by supernatural forces. It is because of them that people can sleep soundly.

They are a blessing, something indispensable, the only thing that can maintain the order in the streets. Each one of them, every day, puts his or her skills to work for the good of the community in which they live, each one of them strives for the good of the world. All, are moved by ideals of justice, tolerance and freedom. However...

Few have been able to see beyond their mask. What the medias report, what people think and say, does not always correspond to the truth. Far from it.

In this Adult Visual Novel you are the one who has decided to fight superheroes. The one who has decided to expose them and their corruption. As a powerful supervillain, you will have to plan your moves against the sexy superheroines you have chosen to fight. You will subdue them and humiliate them, or even fall in love with them and start a relationship.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2211090/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
世界永遠在崩潰的邊緣。外太空的入侵者企圖奴役人類，瘋狂科學家迫不及待要征服地球，異次元的生物靠人們的恐懼與絕望為食。可這一切都不會得逞，因為有他們，願意不惜一切代價保衛地球！

超級英雄。他們美麗、強大，有些誕生於危險的基因實驗，有些來自其他星系，有些得到了超自然力量的饋贈。正是因為有他們，人們才能安睡。

他們是恩賜，是不可或缺的存在，是維持街頭秩序的唯一保障。每一個人，每一天，都在用自己的本領造福生活的社群，都在為世界變好而努力。驅動他們的，是正義、寬容與自由的理想。然而……

沒幾個人見過面具底下的真容。媒體寫的、大家以為的和嘴上說的，並不總是真相。有時甚至相去甚遠。

在這部成人視覺小說裡，你決定與超級英雄為敵，揭露他們的真面目與腐敗行徑。身為強大的超級反派，你要選定對手，謀劃下一步該怎樣對付那些性感女英雄。你可以制服她們、羞辱她們，也可能愛上她們，與她們成為戀人。
